**My top pick: [Producer](#boat/Producer) on Saturday 11/28** — best forecast (7.3/10), strongest **AvgTPA (1.9 trophy fish per angler per day)**, and an overnight gets you offshore to where the yellowfin actually live. The **Win Rate of 21%** (how often Producer beats peer boats on the same day/trip length) is solid for the overnight class. The Sunday Producer trip is nearly booked (only 6 spots), so move quick if you want that one.

If you'd rather dip your toes in with a shorter day, [San Diego](#boat/San%20Diego) has the best Win Rate in the fleet at 30% — but Full Day trips rarely reach the yellowfin zone this time of year.
